title: My First Music Coloring Book (book, cover, KDP listing, Amazon Ads kit)

general-counsel-agent.note: All ten checks on file. Pen name JONNY COLOR keeps the owner anonymous. Nothing commits the owner: no publishing, price or ad spend.

advertising-consumer-protection-counsel.note: Description, back cover, A+ points and ad texts checked against the built book: 30 subjects in four groups (9 + 8 + 7 + 6) exactly as listed, 64 pages, blank backs, name labels and certificate are all true. 'Many with happy faces' is true (19 of 30 pictures have faces). Every named example in the ad texts and headlines (drum, guitar, maracas, piano, trumpet, tambourine, headphones, singing bird) is in the book.

email-anti-spam-compliance-counsel.note: No commercial email. The delivery goes only to the owner.

privacy-data-protection-counsel.note: No personal data in the book, listing or ads kit.

copyright-fair-use-counsel.note: Art is original vector drawing in art/music.js; contact sheet reviewed, no copied drawings, brands or licensed characters. Fredoka font is SIL OFL 1.1, which allows embedding. AI-drawn pages can't be registered for US copyright (Thaler v. Perlmutter), so others may copy them.

trademark-brand-clearance-counsel.note: Web search, no USPTO search run (unreachable). No 'My First Music Coloring Book' title found. MY FIRST COLORING (reg. 4027367, serial 77351497) covers markers, stencils, stamps, drawing mats and puzzles (Classes 16 and 28), not books, and our title doesn't use that phrase. MY FIRST BOOK (application 99585107, 2025, children's activity and coloring books) is pending and not used. Similar descriptive titles exist (Alfred/Belwin's 'My First Music Book (To Color and Play)', a piano method; 'My First Music Alphabet Coloring Book'); our title is descriptive and distinct, and book titles alone aren't protected. Instrument names are generic; keywords and ad keywords name no brands or authors. Owner may run a USPTO search on the 'my first step' series name before publishing.

platform-terms-policy-counsel.note: KDP AI disclosure: answer Yes for images and text, as the listing says. Keywords are 7 phrases of 50 characters or fewer, with no brands or misleading terms. Ad texts and headlines avoid best-seller, sale, price, free and review claims, as Amazon's book ad policy requires; build.js checks passed. The third category (Children's > Arts, Music & Photography > Music > Instruments) should be confirmed in KDP's category picker; if it isn't offered, pick the nearest music category.

kids-content-coppa-counsel.note: Ages 2-5 content is friendly and safe: instruments with happy faces, nothing scary or violent, and nothing pushes purchases on kids. The 'This book belongs to' line collects no data. Fits KDP's children's content guidelines.

contracts-commercial-terms-counsel.note: No contract, quote or terms. The owner publishes and prices on KDP.
